findings.title: Your Stripe webhook accepts anything
findings.detail: Handles Stripe events with no signature check in this file.
findings.forecast: Someone posts a fake "payment succeeded" event to your endpoint and gets your paid plan for free.
findings.fix: Verify every event with stripe.webhooks.constructEvent, using the raw request body and your webhook signing secret, before you act on it.

findings.title: A database table has no row level security
findings.detail: Table profiles is created without row level security.
findings.forecast: Anyone with your public Supabase key can read this table. That key ships in your JavaScript.
findings.fix: Add "alter table <name> enable row level security;" in a new migration, then write a policy that limits each row to its owner.

findings.title: Your AI route has no spending brake
findings.detail: This route calls a paid AI API and the project has no rate limiter.
findings.forecast: One script loops on this endpoint overnight and you wake up to the invoice.
findings.fix: Add a per-user and per-IP rate limit in front of this route, plus a monthly spending cap in your AI provider dashboard.

run1.prompt:
Fix these production problems in order. Change only what each fix needs.
After the fixes, run `npx sigship` again and keep going until it exits 0.
If a fix needs a key rotated or a dashboard changed, stop and tell me what to do.

1. [SEV-1] Your Stripe webhook accepts anything
   Where: src/api/stripe-webhook.ts:3
   Fix: Verify every event with stripe.webhooks.constructEvent, using the raw request body and your webhook signing secret, before you act on it.
2. [SEV-1] A database table has no row level security
   Where: supabase/migrations/001_init.sql:1
   Fix: Add "alter table <name> enable row level security;" in a new migration, then write a policy that limits each row to its owner.
3. [SEV-2] Your AI route has no spending brake
   Where: src/api/chat.ts:2
   Fix: Add a per-user and per-IP rate limit in front of this route, plus a monthly spending cap in your AI provider dashboard.
